goal: Automatically monitor Windows code signing certificate expiration and revocation on a weekly schedule
Avoid release delays by detecting expired or revoked certificates before expedited or point releases
agreement: Unaddressed objection: CRL revocation check fails with an OpenSSL max response length error (hebasto)
Strong support because automated checks ensure certificates work for expedited point releases (fanquake)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because automated monitoring replaces manual discovery during release candidate dry runs
Provides advance warning of expiry or revocation to prevent delays for unexpected point releases
